The vendor directly providing **Salesforce Sales Cloud** at **salesforce.com** is **Salesforce, Inc.** (formerly salesforce.com, inc.).

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official legal terms and agreements hosted on `salesforce.com`:
* **Terms of Service:** *"Please read these Terms carefully because they are a binding agreement between You and Salesforce, Inc. (“Salesforce” or “We”)."*
* **Legal Agreements:** Identifies the contracting entity as *"Salesforce, Inc. (f/k/a salesforce.com, inc.), a Delaware corporation, Salesforce Tower, 415 Mission Street, 3rd Floor, San Francisco, California, 94105, U.S.A."*
